title: EI can peak at a macro scale

statements.text: In model systems whose macro mechanisms are fully fixed by their micro mechanisms, effective information can still peak at a macro spatial or temporal scale.

standing.reason: Candidate for supported: in a worked example, four noisy AND gates have 1.15 bits of effective information at the micro level and 1.55 bits at a two-element macro level, under the stated convention, which the normalization critique disputes as a measure of causation, not as arithmetic.

sources.quote: EI can nevertheless peak at a macro spatiotemporal scale
